board_files.revision_conflict: EPC publishes two layouts: 6-layer (ODB++, landing-page stackup, 2024 test-point report) and 4-layer B5239 Rev 2.0 (Gerber zip, 2023). Which one the purchased board uses is unresolved; check the board's silkscreen revision or ask EPC. Parasitic extraction must use the same revision as the board under test. The revision behind EPC's published QSG waveforms is a separate question; the two need not match.

substantive_differences.R80, R82 (turn-on gate): ODB++ ERJ-2GEJ4R7X (4.7 ohm); BOM RC0402FR-071RL (1 ohm)
substantive_differences.R81, R83 (turn-off gate): ODB++ RC0402FR-071RL (1 ohm); BOM RMCF0402ZT0R00 (0 ohm)

odb_population_vs_bom.other_differences: generic versus full part numbers, and optional parts marked EMPTY in the ODB++
odb_population_vs_bom.footprint: Q1/Q2 use package D0133CT44M, 2.50 x 1.50 mm; EPC links D0133.step from the EPC2204 product page
odb_population_vs_bom.interpretation: the 6-layer ODB++ looks like the same design with a different transistor and gate-resistor population; its copper carries the EPC2204 footprint. Whether its copper matches a shipped EPC9097 is not established.
odb_population_vs_bom.rev2_layout_pdf: names R80-R83 but gives no values or transistor part number
